text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, a cooking practical was held during a sports nutrition class...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
We shall commence cooking immediately!
Our squad will—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Miso soup, tamagoyaki, and a pork bowl... That's it?
Ha, piece of cake!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. All that's left
is to secure her cooperation—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Orfe-san. Let's start with the pork bowl.
Cut the pork with me, sir!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall not.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Being so selfish again!
Enough already, we're doing this! Please cooperate!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
......Meno.
I will not say it twice.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I will not.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I expected as much.
It looks like it will be difficult to have them participate
this time as well.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true. But—
Hishi Ama-nee won't ever give up! Never!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Orfe! Those who do not work shall not eat!
You get to work too!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I refuse.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Orfe-san. You are not a child anymore.
You must fulfill your duties as a student.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...You still don't understand? Flash.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I am a King.
——Before I am ever a student.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...No! You are a student!!
You are, too!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Help out with the cooking already.
You're gonna drag our grades down!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's that?
Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That's right. That teacher is pretty strict...
I heard if someone slacks off,
they lower the grade for the whole group.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? Uh, okay then, I'll try my best.
What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
(A king is one who governs the people.
—To bring them misfortune is the mark of a truly foolish king.)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Orfe-san! Where have you been, sir!
Come, this time for sure! Let us do this together, sir!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Quiet, Meno.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Leave the finishing touches to Us.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
This is the King's luncheon.
Receive it with gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Sports Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Orfe-san made this pork bowl?
You made it together? ...Seriously!!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Well? You did help, sure.
But, Orfe. What you actually did was—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All you did was put red pickled ginger
on the pork bowl we made, didn't you?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And yet, how can you make a face like that?!
As if you were the one who made it!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Yeah.
Was that how it went?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Simply—the King has participated.
Etch that fact into your memory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I was walking down the hallway, I
spotted Orfevre coming out of the cooking room.
choice_data_list: Did the cooking turn out well?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
The pork bowl this time was quite passable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't imagine Orfevre cooking,
but it seems she properly took part in class.
Feeling relieved, I—
choice_data_list: Pork bowl! Eating that is bound to fill you with energy!
Pork bowl! Eating that is bound to fill you with energy!
You managed to cook it that quickly?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't imagine Orfevre cooking,
but it seems she properly took part in class.
Feeling relieved, I—
choice_data_list: Pork bowl! Eating that is bound to fill you with energy!
Pork bowl! Eating that is bound to fill you with energy!
You managed to cook it that quickly?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Do you desire it as well?
A feast fit for a King.
choice_data_list: Huh!? ......Y-You're gonna make it for me!!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ......Heh. Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "If the chance arises—I shall personally add the finishing touch to your pork bowl, with the hands of the King."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
What We undertook was merely a trifling matter.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: However... you're right.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
In recognition of their efforts, next time—
the King shall lend a hand a bit more.
